name: capped-video-mcp
description: Video generation (Seedance, Kling, Veo, Wan) via fal/Replicate with hard budget caps, duplicate protection and cost estimates. Bring your own API key.

fal_key.title: fal API key
fal_key.description: Key from fal.ai/dashboard/keys (API scope, not ADMIN). Leave empty if you only use Replicate.

replicate_api_token.title: Replicate API token
replicate_api_token.description: Token from replicate.com/account/api-tokens. Leave empty if you only use fal.

default_model.title: Default model
default_model.description: Model alias used when a request names none. One of: seedance-2.5, seedance-2.5-fal, kling-3.0, wan-2.5, veo-3.1-fast, veo-3.1-lite, hailuo-2.3, gemini-omni-1.2-flash.

daily_max_usd.title: Daily budget (USD)
daily_max_usd.description: The server refuses generations that would push today's estimated spend above this.

monthly_max_usd.title: Monthly budget (USD)
monthly_max_usd.description: Same cap for the calendar month.

confirm_above_usd.title: Confirm above (USD)
confirm_above_usd.description: Ask you before any generation estimated at or above this amount. 0 disables.
